text:
I can't say whether this asset is deforestation-free, because the analysis never ran for it.

The land-change statistics step returned an error. The source coverage that ASSET-K needs hadn't been prepared, so no observations were made. The run metadata only lists the settings and datasets that would have been used:

- Baseline date: 31 Dec 2020
- Tree cover threshold: 30%
- Minimum event size: 0.5 ha
- Datasets: Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change and JRC GFC2020

The metadata also shows no asset area (null). The engine is early access.

This is not evidence of no deforestation. It is an absence of any result.

Next step: have the coverage for ASSET-K prepared, then rerun the analysis. Until then, treat the asset's status as undetermined.
